page.faq.partner-compatibility.p.totem-a: Totem Astrology ilapha ukuze ikusize ufunde ukukhuluma izilimi zenani zomunye nomunye kangcono futhi uqonde lapho ubonakala sengathi ufuna izinto ezihlukile kodwa ungase uswele ulwazi lwamagama lokukhuluma ngalokho kuhluka. Uma INkawu izama ukwenza iNyathi ukuthi igibele esihlahleni, iNyathi cishe ngeke ikuthande ukugxekwa nokuphikelela njalo kweNkawu kokuthi “kulula! Noma ubani angakwenza!” Njengoba singabantu, futhi laba kumane kuyiziqondiso zethu zezilwane, kungaba usizo ukuqaphela lapho esingase sithole khona izeluleko ezishayisanayo ezivela kubaqondisi abahlukene ngaphakathi kwethu, kanye nomehluko phakathi kwabaqondisi bethu nalabo esibathandayo.
page.faq.partner-compatibility.p.using-t: Sisebenzisa lolu limi lwalesi simiso sezinkanyezi, singakhuluma ngalowo mehluko ngendlela ewenza ubonakale ungeyena umuntu siqu ngoba sinezimpawu zezilwane esincike kuzo ukuze siqonde. Khona-ke umuntu onomhlahlandlela weNkawu angahlala ahlehle futhi ahambe “gotcha, Inyathi yakho ayikuthandi ukuba ibheke phansi, lokho kunengqondo ngokuphelele,” avele ayiyeke. Okungcono kakhulu, Totem Astrology isisiza ukuthi singagcini nje ngokuyekethisa ukuze sihluke, kodwa empeleni sibungaze lowo mehluko futhi sifunde ukuthi uvelaphi ukuze kungadingeki ukuthi sihlulele ngaso sonke isikhathi!
page.faq.partner-compatibility.p.it-also: Kusisiza futhi ukuthi sibone ukuthi izingxenye ezinhle zabanye zixhunywe kanjani ezingxenyeni esingase sizibone njengamaphutha - isibonelo, umngane wakho angase afike sekwephuzile kuma-aphoyintimenti kaningi, kubonakale sengathi ikhanda lakhe liphezu kwamafu. Mhlawumbe banekati noma Inyamazane njengenye yeziqondiso zabo, ukuze ukubambezeleka kufike kuhlanganiswe nomthamo onempilo wokuqamba okuyiphupho! Noma mhlawumbe omunye wabaqondisi babo iNgwe noma Ihhashi, futhi ukubambezeleka kwabo njalo ngezikhathi ezihleliwe kufika kuhlanganiswe nokulungela ukungena esenzweni ngesibindi ngokushesha! Lezi akuzona izaba zokuziphatha ngokungahloniphi, kodwa zingamafasitela kulokho okungenzeka kwenzeka ngaphakathi kwakho noma omunye umuntu - umgomo ngaso sonke isikhathi kuwukulungisa noma yikuphi ukushiyeka kwangaphakathi nokuba nomusa endleleni nokushiyeka kwabanye.
page.faq.partner-compatibility.p.these-a: Lezi ziqondiso zezilwane ziyisipho, hhayi isijeziso! Ngakho-ke khululeka, futhi uhambe kalula kulabo abaseduze nawe. Sonke silapha kulo mgqomo we-loony senza konke okusemandleni ethu, futhi uma siwa namuhla, singaphinda sizithathe kusasa. Okungcono nokho, singasiza ukucoshana, ikakhulukazi uma sazi okwengeziwe ngalokho esingase sikudinge ngamunye nokuthi sivelaphi. Umsebenzi omningi engiwenzile nemindeni uhambisana ngqo nale migqa - ukusiza abazali baqonde ukuthi kwenzekani ebuchosheni bezingane zabo, nokusiza izingane ziqonde ukuthi izindinganiso zabazali bazo zivelaphi.
page.faq.partner-compatibility.p.that-dr: Leyo Dragon izofuna inhlonipho (futhi kungcono imnike yona!), futhi lelo Cat lizobe libonga inhlonipho yakho ngendawo yalo ngaphandle kokuhlala lingena, futhi liyobe likubusisa ngezimanga ezinhle obungazilindele lapho umoya wothando uhlasela. Uma kukhona into eyodwa esingayifunda kulesi simiso, indlela yokubekezelana, ukubheka ngokujulile futhi sizame ukubona ukuthi yini ekhuthaza lokho okunye ukuthatha iqiniso ngaphandle kokuzenzakalelayo "uyisilima!" Singcono kunalokho, futhi singaphathana kangcono kunalokho, futhi ngethemba ukuthi isistimu yami ikusiza ukukunikeza ulimi olwengeziwe ongakwenza ngalo. Jabulela! :)
page.faq.same-animals-different-people.p: “Umngane wami unesilwane esifanayo soNyaka/Ingqondo/Usuku/Ihora nesami kodwa basahluke kakhulu! Kungenzeka kanjani lokho?”

Ungacabanga ngezilwane ezinjengamakhadi owaphathwa ekuqaleni komdlalo we-poker. Nobabili ningase nibe nezinhliziyo ezingu-7 kanye ne-Jack of Diamonds, kodwa ukuthi nizidlala kanjani emdlalweni kukuwe futhi zingabukeka zihluke kakhulu ngaphandle, nakuba unamakhadi afanayo. Noma ungacabanga ngakho njengezincwadi ezinhle ozifundile. Abantu ababili abehlukene bangafunda izincwadi ezine ezifanayo bese bethula inkulumo kusasa ngazo futhi bayoba izinkulumo ezimbili ezihluke kakhulu, nakuba zikhuluma ngendikimba efanayo yalezo zincwadi ezine. Zisebenza kanjalo izilwane: zikhona njenge-encyclopedia ukuze udwebe kuyo yonke impilo yakho, hhayi iqhinga elithile lomlingo elikutshela ukuthi ungubani noma ukuthi kufanele ube ngubani. Ulwazi nje onalo ngezinye zezipho ozinikiwe.

Futhi Totem Astrology akuyona yonke into ekhona emhlabeni, njenganoma iyiphi enye ingxenye yobuwena ongase uyithande akuzona ubuwena obugcwele: uhlanga lwakho, inkolo yakho, izwe ophuma kulo, konke lokhu kungase kube izingxenye ezibalulekile zethu, futhi kubaluleke kakhulu ngezinye izikhathi kunakwabanye, futhi kubaluleke kakhulu kwabanye abantu kunakwabanye. Into efanayo nge-Totem Astrology — mhlawumbe ibaluleke kakhulu ekusebenzelaneni kwakho namuhla, mhlawumbe akunjalo! Kuthathe ngohlamvu lukasawoti, kuhloselwe ukwazisa nokujabulisa - kunokuba umthwalo noma isiqalekiso, kuhloswe ukuba kube isibusiso! Ngakho ujabulele :)
page.faq.p.more-questions-and-answers-wi: Eminye imibuzo nezimpendulo zizongezwa lapha njengoba zivela.
page.faq.p.read-how-the-system-works-try: Funda ukuthi isistimu isebenza kanjani, zama isibali, noma thumela umlayezo uma kukhona okunye okusemqondweni wakho.
page.how.p.the-language-behind-your-four: Ulimi olungemuva kweziqondiso zakho ezine ze-totem - kanye nezendlalelo eziphendula isigxobo se-totem sibe imephu ukuze uziqonde wena nabanye.
page.how.philosophy.p.totem-astrology-is: Totem Astrology yakhelwe ethembeni — ithemba lokuziqonda ngokucacile, ithemba lokuqonda abantu obathandayo, futhi uthemba ukuthi ukuhambisana kuyiqiniso: ukuthi kukhona ozakwethu, abangani, namalungu omndeni angahlangana nawe lapho ukhona. Iziqondiso ezine zezilwane ziwulimi olwabiwe lwalelo themba. Basinika okuthile okungacacile esingakukhomba lapho ukuphila kwangaphakathi kuzwakala kuxakile noma kunzima ukukuchaza.
page.how.philosophy.p.this-system-is-not: Lolu hlelo alusona izaba zokuziphatha okubi, futhi aluyona imvume yokubekezelela ukuziphatha okubi kwabanye abantu. Kuyithuluzi lokuqonda — lokubona ukuthi izindlela ezihlukene zangaphakathi zisebenza kanjani, ukwazisa lowo mehluko, nokunikeza umusa lapho ukuqonda kuvula indawo yakho. Ukuziphendulela nozwelo kuhlangene.
page.how.four-guides.p.totem-astrology-b: Totem Astrology yakhela phezu kwe-Chinese Four Pillars of Destiny — unyaka wokuzalwa, inyanga, usuku, nehora. Insika ngayinye yembula umngane oyedwa wesilwane se-totem: Spiritual, Mental, Emotional, kanye Physical inkomba yakho Ndawonye bakha isigxobo esisodwa se-totem - izingxenye ezine zesikhathi sokuzalwa okukodwa, ezipakishwe kusukela kuMzimba phansi ukusuka ku-Heart and Mind to Spirit zithweswe umqhele phezulu.
page.how.five-elements.p.water-wood-fire: Amanzi, Izinkuni, Umlilo, Umhlaba, Nensimbi - ingxenye ngayinye yesigxobo sakho se-totem ibhanqa isilwane neyodwa yalezi Zici Ezinhlanu, okungeza ungqimba olunembile lokuthungwa kumhlahlandlela wakho wezilwane woMoya, Ingqondo, Inhliziyo, Nomzimba. I-Five Elements ingabuye icatshangwe njengezifanekiso ezinhlanu zokunyakaza kwamandla - ngasinye sinendlela yaso, ingqondo, nezinkulumo ze-Yin & Yang.
page.how.yin-yang.p.before-rainbow-compa: Ngaphambi kozakwabo boThingo, amabhondi ethunzi, nanoma iyiphi ingqondo yokumatanisa ingena esithombeni, Yin kanye ne-Yang izindlela ezimbili ezibalulekile amandla ahamba ngazo. I-polarity ibhakwa esilwaneni ngasinye se-totem kusukela ekuqaleni - i-Squirrel ihlale i-Yang, i-Buffalo ihlale iyi-Yin, i-Tiger ihlale i-Yang, i-Cat ihlale iyi-Yin, njalo njalo kuzo zonke eziyishumi nambili.
page.how.yin-yang.p.yang-initiates-exten: U-Yang uqala, uyanweba, futhi uyagomela - ephumela ngaphandle emhlabeni obonakalayo. I-Yin ithola, ijule, futhi iqedele - iqoqana ngaphakathi ekuthuleni nasekucwengweni. I-totem pole yakho ixuba kokubili, kodwa i-polarity yesilwane ngasinye ayishintshi.
page.how.values-triangles.p.the-twelve-t: Izilwane eziyishumi nambili ze-totem zihlangana zibe ngonxantathu abane, ngayinye ihlelwe ngokwenani eliyinhloko: Amandla & Prestige, Ukuzinza & Ukuphepha, Inspiration & I-Idealism, kanye Ukuthula & Ukuvumelana. Zonke izilwane zibeka phambili eyodwa yalawa lens lapho senza izinqumo ezibalulekile - hhayi kuphela, kodwa okokuqala.
page.how.sacred-roles.p.within-each-valu: Ngaphakathi kwe-Values ​​Triangle ngayinye, lezi zilwane ezintathu zidlala enye yeZindima Ezingcwele ezintathu: Umfuni, uMage, noma iRoyal - izindlela ezintathu ezihlukene zokuhlanganisa inani eliyinhloko lalowonxantathu. Inani elifanayo lingalandelwa ngokuqondile futhi lakhelwe phezu kwalo, lisetshenziswe ngobuqili futhi kudlalwe ngalo, noma lifakwe njengegunya lemvelo futhi liboniswe ngesibindi.
page.how.nepal-time.p.before-your-animal: Ngaphambi kokuba izilwane zakho zibalwe, siguqula isikhathi sakho sokuzalwa sibe Nepal Time (NPT) — ukushintsha kwendawo yesikhathi okusekelwe ekutholeni okunembile kokuthi lolu hlelo olubizwa ngokuthi "I-Chinese Astrology" empeleni lunomsuka walo ezinganekwaneni ezimayelana no-Jade Emperor, owayehlala phezu kweNtaba i-Jade e-Tiben Mountain Ratben esebenza emngceleni we-Lunern esenyakatho ye-K'unbern. Ibe isilethwa kithina bantu ivela kuBuddha, indawo yakhe yokuzalwa ngokwesiko ithathwa njengeseNepal. Ngakho-ke ukuguqula izikhathi zokuzalwa zibe i-NPT kuqala kusiza izilwane zosuku nehora zihambisane namaqiniso abantu abawaqaphelayo emhlabeni wonke Ezinhliziyweni Nasemizimbeni yabo.
page.how.p.enter-your-birth-details-and-: Faka imininingwane yakho yokuzalwa futhi uhlangabezane neziqondiso zakho ezine ze-totem - bese uchofoza noma yiliphi ikhadi ukuze ujule.
article.values.p.a-framework-for-underst: Uhlaka lokuqonda ukuthi isilwane ngasinye se-totem sibeka kanjani phambili lokho okubaluleke kakhulu - nokuthi kungani senza ukukhetha okuhlukile.
article.values.p.we-all-aim-for-these-to: Sonke sihlose lokhu ngokwezinga elithile, kodwa sikubeka eqhulwini ngendlela ehlukile. Unxantathu ngamunye wezilwane usebenzisa Ivelu ehlukile njengokukhanya kwayo okuyisiqondiso. Chofoza ku-Value ukuze ufunde mayelana nonxantathu wayo wezimpawu zezilwane nokuthi ngayinye imelela kanjani
article.values.p.squirrel-dragon-and-mon: I-Squirrel, Dragon, kanye neNkawu - uMfuni, uNdlunkulu kanye neMage.
article.values.p.buffalo-serpent-and-pho: Inyathi, iNyoka, kanye nePhoenix - uMfuni, uMage, kanye neRoyal.
article.values.p.tiger-horse-and-wolf-th: Ingwe, Ihhashi, kanye Nempisi - iRoyal, uMfuni, kanye neMage.
article.values.p.cat-deer-and-bear-the-m: Ikati, Inyamazane, neBhere - iMage, Umfuni, kanye neRoyal.
article.values.p.when-the-zodiac-is-divi: Lapho i-zodiac ihlukaniswa yaba ngonxantathu abane abalinganayo, amaqembu aphumayo ezilwane ezintathu ngalinye liqoqana libeka phambili inani eliyisisekelo elilodwa ngaphezu kwamanye. Lokhu akusho ukuthi banendaba kuphela nalelo nani ngaphandle kwakho konke okunye, ukuthi nje bavame ukubona umhlaba ngaleyo lensi kuqala - lapho benza izinqumo ezibalulekile, lelo nani libaluleke kakhulu. Nawa amanani amane:
article.values.li.power-prestige-this-ca: Amandla & I-Prestige — Lokhu kungaba amandla namandla phezu kwakho, njengokucwenga amathalente namakhono okwakha. Kuphinde kubonakale njengamandla emhlabeni wangaphandle, njengokusebenzisa amandla phezu kwabanye, ukugcina isithunzi esithile nokuma okuhle, nokubukeka kuhlaba umxhwele kubantu ababalwayo. Lo nxantathu uzikhathaza ngokukleliswa kanye nokuvelayo kokubili komphakathi kanye nokuyimfihlo, njalo efuna ukuhlonishwa kakhulu. Isebenza kanzima ezintweni ezikwaziyo futhi ifuna ukuthi ziqashelwe futhi zaziwe. Yibo abaziyo ukuthi ubani onesibopho sazo zonke lezi zinto ezinkulu ezisizungezile, ophethe isigaba sabaphathi, futhi lapho esingangena khona Kuso futhi sithole indawo yethu efanele (noma siyithuthukise uma kunesidingo!).
article.values.li.stability-security-thi: Ukuzinza & Ukuphepha — Lezi yizo zonke izinto ezibambekayo ezakha isisekelo sezimpilo zethu zasemhlabeni. Ingabonakala ngaphakathi nangaphandle - njengokuzihlonipha noma ukuthi abanye abantu bakwazisa kanjani, isibonelo. Ngokuqinisekile ihlanganisa izinkomba zangaphandle zokuphepha, njengekhaya esilala kulo, ikhwalithi yokudla esikudlayo, kanye nokuthi siyenza malini. Lo nxantathu ugxile ezintweni ezingafakazelwa futhi okuthenjelwe kuzo, izinto esingazithinta empeleni, ezisazoba khona kusasa yiza imvula noma licwebe. Yibo abenza isiqiniseko sokuthi kukhona ukudla efrijini nasendaweni ethokomele ukuze bazigoqe ekupheleni kosuku.
article.values.li.idealism-inspiration-t: I-Idealism & Ugqozi — Lapha kulapho abaphuphayo behlala khona - basuke benesizathu sokuhle nokubi. Ngokuvamise ukuzinikela kuNkululeko, Ubuzalwane & Nodadewenu, Ukulingana, Isithunzi, Ukuhlonishwa, kanye Nobuqotho, baphilela ukuletha le Migomo Ekuphileni kungenjalo yini iphuzu? Lonxantathu unamagquma abazofela kuwo, ngokuziqhenya sengathi ayikho enye indlela. Bagcina ukugxila kwabo kumanani ezithombe ezinkulu, ngakho bayashesha ukuxolela futhi baqhubekele phambili. Yibo abavikela ngokuqinile okulungile nokulungile, benza isiqiniseko sokuthi iQiniso liyawina njalo ekugcineni.
article.values.li.peace-harmony-this-is-: Ukuthula & I-Harmony — Lobu ubuciko bokugcina i-vibe ipholile ngaso sonke isikhathi. Abakuthandi ukungqubuzana futhi bazothatha amasu amade ukuyizungeza uma kungenzeka, babhekane nayo kuphela lapho ihlehliswe ekhoneni. Esikhundleni salokho, bangompetha ekutholeni ukuvumelana nokufuna izixazululo ze-win-win ezishiya wonke umuntu ejabule. Abahlala begqugquzelwa ukujabulela izinto ezinhle empilweni njengo-Winnie the Pooh, bayajabula ukwabelana nawe ngalokhu inqobo nje uma ungabahlukumezi ubumnandi babo. Ninokuthula ndawonye noma ninokuthula ngokwehlukana, kukuwe ngokuphelele, kodwa bayoba nokuthula. Yibo abaqinisekisa ukuthi ukuthula kuyavikelwa, ukuthula okungcwele kuyahlonishwa, futhi ukudlala ngokuzwana ndawonye kuyigama lomdlalo.
article.values.power-triangle.p.the-powe: Unxantathu Wamandla uboniswa ngezilwane zoku-1, zesi-5, nezesi-9 ze-zodiac: Ingwejeje, Idrako, kanye Nenkawu.
article.values.power-triangle.p.the-squi: I-Squirrel, njengesilwane sokuqala se-zodiac, izama ukuthola amandla. Ikuphishekela ngokuyinhloko ngokuqapha kanye nokubeka emphakathini - ukuqoqa ubuhlakani, ukufunda izikhundla, kanye nokufika ngaphambi komncintiswano. Ifuna ukwazi kuze kube phakade, iyachuma ku-dynamics yeqembu hhayi ngoba ilangazelela ukuba yingxenye, kodwa ngenxa yokuthi amanethiwekhi yilapho okuhlala khona inzuzo: ubani owaziyo, ubani olawula ukufinyelela, ubani owacwayiza kuqala lapho uklebe edlula phezulu.

Ubudlelwano beSquirrel naMandla bunjengoMfuni, ohlale enesifiso sokuthola okwengeziwe, kodwa hhayi ngendlela efiselekayo. Ku-squirrel, kufana nomdlalo ongapheli wokulungela — lowo athanda ukuwina kaningi ngangokunokwenzeka, ikakhulukazi uma ebona ukuvuleka okunganakiwe noma afihle ingxenye ebalulekile yolwazi olukhokha ngesikhathi esifanele. Ama-squirrels anohlobo lobudlelwano bezithandani namandla: athanda ngempela ukuhlala phambili, ngezinye izikhathi asaba labo ababambe indawo ephakeme, futhi ngokuvamile ajatshuliswe ukujaha ngokwako.
article.values.power-triangle.p.the-drag: Ngakolunye uhlangothi, ubuhlobo be-Dragon namandla, bufana noBukhosi balo nxantathu. Imane inamandla, futhi iwasebenzisa ngokuthanda kwayo. Iyazi ukuthi izinto kufanele zibe kanjani, ngokuzethemba impela, futhi iziqondise ukuthi zibe njalo ngaphandle kokuchitha isikhathi. Amadragoni angabavikeli besizinda sawo, futhi abuka noma yini engaphansi kwawo njengombuso wawo siqu.
article.values.power-triangle.p.they-can: Bangase babe ngabaphethe, izithandani, abalingani, amaphrojekthi, noma abasebenzi, kodwa ngalokho kuba nakho kuhambisana nokugada okuqinile kanye nenhlonipho eqinile ngekhwalithi. Kubo kuyingcebo abayigadile, futhi ingcebo bayazi uma beyibona. Igunya labo lemvelo lisho ukuthi ngisho noma bengaphethe ngokobuchwepheshe esigabeni sesigaba, bathola indlela yokukhipha iziqondiso noma kunjalo, okuvame ukudumaza labo abangabaphathi babo ngokusemthethweni. Lobu budlelwano namandla bubanika ikhono lemvelo lokuyala isikhungo, futhi bagcwaliseka kakhulu lapho izimpilo zabo zibanikeza ithuba lokuguquguquka la mandla.
article.values.power-triangle.p.the-monk: I-Monkey, njengesilwane sesithathu nesokugcina kuleli qembu, ibonisa amandla njengeMage. Bazalwa benokuqonda okungokwemvelo kwamandla dynamics, kanye nabathandi abakhulu bemidlalo ngokwabo, bayisebenzisa cishe ngokungazi. Kubo, abakwenzayo kumane kunengqondo, kodwa ngokombono wabanye kungase kubukeke njengemishini eyinkimbinkimbi. Bahlakaniphe kakhulu, ngezinye izikhathi baze babonise ukuqonda okuncane ukuze balethe kancane kancane abaphikisi babo ekuboneni kwabo.
article.values.power-triangle.p.their-po: Amandla abo afana neNdoda Engemuva Kwekhethini kuMthakathi wase-Oz. Hhayi nje esiteji ukuze bonke babonwe, kodwa kunalokho ngokwenza ngobuhlakani lokho okufanele kwenziwe ngaphandle kwesiteji, njengoba beqaphela ukuthi ukufeza umgomo kuyinto ebaluleke kakhulu, hhayi ukuthi ubani othola udumo ngakho. Kunesizathu esenza ukuthi uMfene kanye neNkawu bazwakale befana: bobabili banentshisekelo enkulu kokwenzekayo ngemuva komdlalo thina sonke esiwubiza ngokuthi ngokoqobo. NjengoMage walonxantathu, ngezinye izikhathi abonakala engenawo amandla nhlobo, kodwa lokhu kuwukubukeka nje.
article.values.security-triangle.p.the-s: Unxantathu Wezokuphepha uboniswa ezilwaneni ze-zodiac yesi-2, yesi-6, neyeshumi: iNyathi, iNyoka, nePhoenix.
article.values.security-triangle.p.as-th: Njengesilwane sokuqala sikanxantathu Wezokuphepha, iNyathi inguMfuni Wezokuphepha. Lokhu kusho umsebenzi, ukuzibophezela, nokuzinikela kokuthile okubambekayo. Ibona ukubaluleka kwemvelo kulokho okungathintwa futhi kuthenjelwe kukho ngokuqinile, futhi izama ukudala lolu hlobo lokuzinza empilweni yayo yalabo ethembeke kuyo. INyathi iyaphikelela, ikhetha indlela yendabuko kanye nezindlela ezivivinywayo nezivivinywayo. Umzamo ongaguquki uveza imiphumela ehlala njalo, ngakho-ke iNyathi ifeza imisebenzi abanye abebengayiyeka kudala.
article.values.security-triangle.p.they-: Ngokwemvelo bathembekile, futhi bayabasola labo abangenjalo. Kubo, umhlambi ubaluleke kakhulu, futhi ukunikeza abathandekayo babo ukulondeka kuyibheji lodumo, kungakhathaliseki ukuthi kungakanani ukuhlupheka okumelwe kubekezelelwe ukuze bathole lokhu kulondeka. Kungathatha iminyaka, kodwa iNyathi izoyakha.
article.values.security-triangle.p.lying: INyoka elele emkhathini wezinkanyezi. Ichitha ingxenye enkulu yempilo yayo igcwele, ithintana ngqo nomzimba noMhlaba, ihlanganisa ubuhlakani beplanethi, futhi ingaqondwa njengoMage of Security. Iqaliswe ezimfihlakalweni zokuthi Ukuvikeleka kusho ukuthini ngempela, iNyoka isiyikho, ngakho ingayithola cishe noma yikuphi.
article.values.security-triangle.p.snake: Izinyoka ziyakwazi ukuzivumelanisa nezimo ngokungenamkhawulo, zinomuzwa ozwakalayo, ozwakalayo wokuthi yini ephephile nokuthi yini engekho. Ukuvikeleka kwawo cishe kuyimfihlo, njengoba kungase kungabonakali ezinzile ngokukhethekile ngaphandle ngenxa yokuthi ahlala eshintsha, kodwa empeleni anekhono elihlala likhona lokuthola ukuvikeleka konke ngesikhathi esisodwa, ngokuphazima kweso, ezisonta kunoma yiliphi igatsha noma isakhiwo esiseduze. Imfihlo iwukuvumelana nezimo nokuvumelana nezimo, ukuzimisela kwabo ukuzilungisa ngaphansi kwezimo. Bazamukela izimo njengoba zinjalo futhi bazilungise ngokufanele, basebenze kuphela ukuguqula izinto uma kunesidingo futhi uma sebevele belukwe ngokuqinile esakhiweni ngokwabo.
article.values.security-triangle.p.the-p: IPhoenix, njengeRoyal yalonxantathu, imemezela ukuphepha. Kubo, ukuzinza nokulondeka kumane kuyindlela izinto eziyiyo, futhi abanamahloni ukwazisa abanye. Ukubonisa kwabo Ukuvikeleka kuqinisekisa kwabathandekayo ababazungezile, ngaleyo ndlela bayala ngendlela eyi-Yin eyenza ngayo iNdlovukazi, ukuba khona kwabo okunethezeka okwenza kwaziwe ukuthi indawo iphephile ngempela, ivikelekile, futhi yamukeleka.
article.values.security-triangle.p.they-: Zinkulu ekubonisweni, futhi zikwazi kahle ukubaluleka kokubonakala. I-Phoenix ijabulela ukusingathwa, ukwethula, nokuphatha imvelo ngobuhlakani. Bayabona ukuthi ukucophelela nokuboniswa kwekhwalithi kokubili kuyaqinisekisa futhi kuyaphumuza njengoba kudlulisa isithembiso sokuphepha ngokomfanekiso. Kuwuhlobo lwamandla oluboniswa ngokunethezeka, okuqondiswe ku-hemisphere yesokudla yobuchopho futhi ehloselwe ukuqondwa ngokubonisa kunokukutshela - nakuba bengavamile ukukungabaza ukukutshela ukuthi bazizwa kanjani. Umbono uyisimemezelo, isethulo, ukuvezwa - kubeke lapho, kubonise umhlaba, makwaziwe!
article.values.inspiration-triangle.p.th: I-Inspiration Triangle ivuthelwa ezilwaneni zesi-3, zesi-7, nese-11 ze-zodiac: Ingwe, Ihhashi, kanye Nempisi.

Ingwe, njengeRoyal yalonxantathu, ihlanganisa Ukuphefumlelwa ngokwemvelo njengoba ilangabi linikeza ukushisa. Ubukhosi, ukuqiniseka, kanye nesiqiniseko esicacile salokho okufanele kube akuzona izinto eziphikisana ngazo - zivele zigqame kukho. Abanye bazizwa befanelekile lapho ukhona ngaphambi kokuba kukhulunywe igama elilodwa: ukuphakanyiswa, ukuphonselwa inselelo, ukukhunjuzwa ukuthi ukuphila kungashisa kakhulu futhi kusho okwengeziwe. I-Tiger ayijahi i-Inspiration kangangokuthi ime njengobufakazi bayo obuphilayo.

Bangabavikeli abanonya balokho abakholelwa kukho, futhi igunya labo kulo mbuso alinaphutha. Abavikeli bezizathu, izithandwa, kanye nemibono ngokufanayo, bavikela okuhle nokuyiqiniso ngentshiseko engavumeli ukuyekethisa - hhayi ngokufuna ukwethembeka, kodwa ngokuhola ngesibonelo kuze kube yilapho abanye bekhetha ukulandela. I-charisma yabo yemvelo isho ukuthi noma bengaphethe ngokusemthethweni, igumbi livame ukuzungeza umuzwa wabo wokuthi yini ebalulekile. NjengeNdlunkulu yalo nxantathu, iNgwe ibambe isikhungo Sokuphefumlelwa ngamandla angenakuzikhandla, futhi igcwaliseka kakhulu lapho impilo ibanika ithuba lokuhlanganisa okuhle emhlabeni wonke.
article.values.inspiration-triangle.p.as: Njengesilwane sesibili sikanxantathu Wokuphefumulelwa, Ihhashi lingumFundi Wokuphefumulelwa. Lokhu kusho ukulambela okungaphumuli komkhathizwe ovulekile - endaweni elandelayo, ithuba elilandelayo, amazwibela alandelayo wokuthi impilo ingaba yini uma umuntu eqhubeka nokugijima ebheke kuyo. IHhashi alimane nje libabaze imibono likude; igijima ibheke kubo. Inkululeko iwuhlobo lwemali yayo, futhi umoya ekuhlakanipheni kwayo umuzwa wokuqiniseka ngokwawo. Lapho into ithatha umcabango wayo, wonke umuntu uya phambili: amanqina ashaya ngamandla, izinzwa zibanzi, izwe elivamile elishiywe efwini lothuli nezithembiso.
article.values.inspiration-triangle.p.th: Ubudlelwano babo Nogqozi lobo bomuntu ozinikele, odonseleka kuze kube phakade kulokho okungaba khona kunalokho okuyikho. Bathanda iphutha, ngezinye izikhathi benza iphutha lokujabula kokugijima ukuze bafike egoli uqobo. Nokho lokhu kungazinzi kuyisipho sabo: bathwala abanye endleleni yabo, futhi umfutho wabo othathelanayo ungavusa wonke amaqembu ekulangazeleleni kwawo okungakafinyelelwa. Ehhashini, okuhle ngaphandle kokunyakaza akubekezeleleki - ngakho-ke ayagijima, agxume, futhi ahole ukusuka phambili.

Impisi, njengesilwane sesithathu nesokugcina kuleli qembu, ikhombisa ugqozi njengeMage. Iqaliswe ezimfihlakalweni ezijulile zokuthi izindinganiso zibiza malini ngempela nokuthi zisho ukuthini ngempela, Impisi iyaqonda ukuthi Ukuphefumlelwa akuhlali kunomsindo noma kubonakala. Kwesinye isikhathi ihamba ngokwethembeka, ngephakethe, ngamaculo aculwa ebumnyameni kanye nezinhlelo ezibekwe ngokuthula. Bayakwazi ukondla ilangabi lingashisi umhlaba.
article.values.inspiration-triangle.p.wo: Izimpisi zingama-idegicists. Bangakwazi ukuzwa ukuthi yimiphi imibono ezohlala futhi ezovutha, futhi batshale imali ngokufanele - kubantu, ngezimbangela, ngobusuku obude ngaphambi kokuntwela kokusa. Ugqozi lwabo luhlobene futhi lusendle, lugxile ekubeni yingxenye kodwa alwesabi umkhawulo onganqunyiwe. Bangase bangabi ngabokuqala ukumemezela iphupho, kodwa ngokuvamile yibona abaligcina liphila lapho abanye sebephelelwe amandla. NjengoMage walonxantathu, Impisi kwesinye isikhathi ibonakala ingokoqobo noma igadiwe, kodwa ngaphansi kwalokho kulele ukuzinikela kokuhle njengolaka nokubekezela njengobusika uqobo.
article.values.harmony-triangle.p.the-ha: I-Harmony Triangle ivezwa ngezilwane zesi-4, zesi-8, nese-12 ze-zodiac: Ikati, Inyamazane, kanye neBhere.
article.values.harmony-triangle.p.the-ca: Ikati, njengeMage walonxantathu, liqonda Ukuvumelana ngendlela ikati eliqonda ngayo umsebe welanga - hhayi ngokuwuhlaziya, kodwa ngokuzinza kuwo ngomzwelo ongokwemvelo ophelele. Ziyadlala, ziyaxaka, futhi zinenhlanhla exakile, zihlanganisa ubumnandi nokucijile ngesilinganiso esilinganayo, zazi kahle ukuthi kunini lapho kufanele kuthanjiswe khona igumbi nokuthi kufanele kukhanye nini uzipho. Ukunaka kwabo kugxuma ngokushesha njengoba benza, futhi ngokugxuma ngakunye balungisa isimo sezulu esingokomzwelo ngaphandle kokuba noyedwa oqaphelayo ukuthi kwenzeke kanjani.
article.values.harmony-triangle.p.cats-d: Amakati awashumayeli ukuthula; bayayinjiniyela. I-purr enesikhathi esihle, isiphazamiso samahlaya, ukuguqulwa kwesihloko okungazelelwe okulethwe ngendlela ekhangayo kangangokuthi ukucasuka akunandawo yokufika - lawa amathuluzi abo. Bangochwepheshe bokuthinta ukukhanya, babuyisela ibhalansi ngokusebenzisa i-wit esikhundleni sesisindo, futhi isipho sabo siwukwenza ukuzwana kuzizwe kunzima ngisho nalapho umsebenzi ongemuva kwakho uhlakaniphe ngempela. NjengoMage walonxantathu, ikati ngezinye izikhathi libonakala lizicabangela lona ngokwalo noma lingazinaki, kodwa ngaphansi kwalokho kulele ukuhambisana okujulile kwemizwa yeqembu kanye nokuzinikela okuthulile ekuligcineni liphelele.
article.values.harmony-triangle.p.as-the: Njengesilwane sesibili sikanxantathu we-Harmony, iNhlangakazi inguMfuni Wokuvumelana. The Mysterious Deer — izimfihlakalo ngisho kubo ngokwabo. Okuthile ngabo kubonakala kungokwemvelo: kumnandi kodwa kuyinqaba, njengokuthi banonyawo olulodwa kuphela kulobu bukhulu kanti olunye lusafuna ndawana thize, ethulile, elikhululeke kakhudlwana. Badonseleka kuze kube phakade ekuthuleni hhayi njengendawo engaguquki kodwa njengomuzwa ozwakalayo wokulunga, ukulingana okungaphezu nje komugqa wesihlahla abangawunambitha kodwa abangalokothi bawubambe.
article.values.harmony-triangle.p.their-: Ubuhlobo babo ne-Harmony bobomuntu osuke exosha, ojwayele ukungezwani futhi olangazelela ukubuyisela lokho okuye kwadumazeka. Bazwela iphutha, ngezinye izikhathi bayanyamalala endaweni yabo yangaphakathi lapho umhlaba wangaphandle ukhula unokhahlo kakhulu, kodwa wona kanye lokhu kuzwela kuyisipho sabo: bayaqaphela lokho abanye abaphuthelwa khona - ukushuba kancane kwezwi, ukuvumelana okungabuya uma nje othile engaba nesineke sokulinda. EZinyamazaneni, ukuthula kufanele ukufune ngisho nalapho kubonakala kungenakwenzeka, futhi ukuphikelela kwazo ngokuthula ngokuvamile kuletha ukuthula emakamelweni ayengazi ukuthi awaphumuli.
article.values.harmony-triangle.p.the-be: Ibhere, njengeRoyal yalonxantathu, lihlanganisa iHarmony ngokwemvelo njengoba iziko linikeza imfudumalo. I-Bountiful Bear — enomkhuba ojabulisayo wokuthola ibhodwe legolide ekupheleni kothingo, ijabulela uju olungaphakathi, futhi yabelane ngayo nabo bonke ababathanda kakhulu. Kubo, ukuthula nensada kumane kuyindlela ukuphila okufanele kuzizwe ngayo, futhi ukuba khona kwabo ngokuphana kwenza kube njalo. Abanye bahlala phakathi kwabo ngaphandle kokucelwa, njengokungathi ingxenye ethile yomphefumulo wasendulo ikhumbula ukuthi lapha, ekugcineni, sekwanele.
article.values.harmony-triangle.p.they-a: Bangabavikeli bempilo enhle, hhayi ngamandla kodwa ngobuningi. Itafula eligcwele, umhume wokwamukela, ukuzimisela ukuvumela abathandekayo bamane babe - lezi yizindlela iBhere elibusa ngayo. Bayaqonda ukuthi ukuzwana kweqiniso akukhona ukungabibikho kobunzima kodwa ukuba khona kwesiphephelo: indawo lapho injabulo inganambitha, ukuphumula kungathathwa, futhi ubumnandi bungadluliswa ngaphandle kwezibalo noma isimo. NjengeRoyal yalonxantathu, iBhele liphethe isikhungo seHarmony ngegunya elingaxhamazeli, futhi ligcwaliseka kakhulu lapho umhlaba wabo unikeza indawo yokubuthana, ukondla, nokwabelana.
article.values.rainbow-companions.p.hidd: Ifihlwe ngaphakathi kwe-zodiac njengedayimane, ukubhanqwa kwe-Rainbow okuyisithupha kuhlanganisa izilwane ze-Yin ne-Yang ngokubambisana okuhambisanayo. Ipheya ngalinye lilinganisa amandla angaphakathi nawangaphandle - elinye livame ukuhola emhlabeni, elinye livame ukujula, ukuthambisa, noma ukuqedela lokho okuqaliswa okokuqala. Lapho bobabili bevela esigxotsheni se-totem somuntu, noma ebuhlotsheni obuseduze, bavame ukuthola komunye nomunye i-counterweight yemvelo.
article.values.shadow-companions.p.each-: Njalo isilwane ngasinye sinomngane walo we-Shadow — okuphambene nobudlelwane balo be-Rainbow. Lapho i-Rainbow idonsa imibala yangempela yomuntu ngemuva kokukhanya, i-Shadow inomlingo omnyama, iveza amaphutha ngokucacile ngokuphelele (lokho kusho ukuthi kungcono ukuwathuthukisa!). Kokubili lobu budlelwane bunesihlabathi esinamandla; umehluko ukuthi i-Rainbow iveza lokho esekukhanyayo, kuthi i-Shadow iveze lokho okumele ukubhekana nakho futhi kusebenze kukho. Nakanjani sidinga bobabili kuleli zwe, ngakho-ke sivame ukudonswa yibo bobabili! Akukho ukubaleka ku-Shadow yomuntu: inikeza isipho esinzima sokukhombisa amaphutha nokwehluka ngokusobala, ukuze asebenze kuthi kungekwazi ukuwagwema.
article.values.h2.the-dragon-the-cat-two: IDragon & Ikati — Amalensi Amabili Ehlukene Ngokukhetha Okufanayo
article.values.p.for-example-the-dragon-: Isibonelo, i-Dragon isendaweni ye-Power Triangle. Lokhu kusho ukuthi ngokuvamile ihlule izinto ngokusekelwe ekutheni amandla ayo azothinteka kanjani. Ikati lisendaweni ye-Harmony Triangle, ngakho-ke ngokuvamile lihlule izinto ngokusekelwe ekutheni ukuthula kwalo kuzothinteka yini. Lapho lenza isinqumo phakathi kwezinye izindlela zenqubo, i-Dragon ngokuvamile lizobeka isisindo esikhulu kakhulu emiphumeleni yokuhlonishwa kwayo, kuyilapho Ikati lingakhathazeka kakhulu ngokuthi ukuthula kwalo kusegozini yini.
article.values.p.the-dragon-may-thus-cho: UDragon angakhetha ngalendlela izenzo eziningi zokulwa ukuze athole izinzuzo enkundleni yamandla nokuqashelwa, kuyilapho Ikati lingakhetha indlela enobuhlakani, lifuna esikhundleni salokho ukulondolozwa kokuthula nokuhlangana komoya.
article.values.p.neither-animal-welcomes: Akekho isilwane esamukela idumela elonakele noma ukuphazamiseka kokuhlangana, kodwa lapho kumanqikanqika ukukhetha okukodwa noma okunye bazokwenzenjani ngezindlela ezehlukene ngokusekelwe ezingeni balibeka phambili.
article.values.p.the-cat-has-a-relativel: The Cat has a relatively higher tolerance for momentary loss of dignity, able to shake itself off and pounce away with head held high as if nothing happened. It is eager to return to peace and balance, while the same slight would be liable to keep a Dragon up at night, stewing over the loss of face.
article.values.p.meanwhile-the-dragon-ca: Okwamanje, i-Dragon ingakwazi ukubhekana nenani elithile lomthunzi okulahlwa yilabo abandezeleka izimpaphe zabo ngenxa yezenzo zayo, yamukela ukuphazamiseka kwesikhashana kokuthula njengentengo yesikhathi sokufuna izinhloso zayo. Iyangqubuzela ukufezeka kwezinhloso lezo futhi igcina iso layo kumklomelo, kuyilapho i-Cat izithola izolahlwa kakhulu imizwa yobubi eqenjini.
article.values.p.neither-is-right-or-wro: Akulona olungalungile noma olulungile, futhi kokubili izindlela kunezinzuzo nezinkinga zazo — lokhu kuyimangalisa yokuxhumana kwe-Shadow, ngoba kugcizelela lezi zihlukaniso lapho singaziboni noma sicabanga ukuthi abanye abantu nje “bawenza ngendlela engalungile” :)
article.values.p.use-the-free-calculator: Sebenzisa ikhalikhula yamahhala ukukubonisa izilwane zakho zangaphakathi ezingokomoya, ezingokwengqondo, ezingokomzwelo, nezomzimba — bese uhlole ukuthi amathathu azo enani alungiselela kanjani umhlaba wakho wangaphakathi.
article.fourGuides.p.spirit-mind-heart-a: Umoya, Ingqondo, Inhliziyo, noMzimba — izilwane ezine abangane bakho ezihlelwe emtholampilo wakho, zivezwe ngeZiNdonga Ezine zokuzalwa kwakho.
article.fourGuides.p.totem-astrology-bui: Totem Astrology isekelwe ku-Four Pillars of Destiny yaseShayina — unyaka wokuzalwa, inyanga, usuku, kuwela. Ipini ngalinye libonisa isilwane sekhasi elilodwa: acksoni Yakho Yomoya, Mental, Emotional, kanye nabaqondisi bakho Physical.
article.fourGuides.p.the-year-pillar-spe: Iphayili lonyaka likhuluma ngomkhuba wakho wokomoya — umugqa omkhulu wokuthi uba umuntu onjani impilo yonke. Iphayili lenyanga luma indlela ocabanga ngayo nokuthi uhlaziya kanjani umhlaba. Iphayili losuku lifinyelela enhliziyweni — indlela ozizwa ngayo, oxhumana ngayo, nokuthi ukhetha kanjani empilweni yansuku zonke. Iphayili lehora liyanamathisela emzimbeni — umuzwa, amandla, kanye nesigqi somzimba ohamba naso emhlabeni.
article.fourGuides.p.picture-them-stacke: Zibonele zidweliswe njengephayiphu le-totem — Umzimba esisekelweni, Inhliziyo phezulu, Ingqondo okulandelayo, futhi Umoya uphakame kakhulu. Ndawonye, lezi zilwane ezine azizona ama-horoscope ahlukene amane aphakanyiswe ndawonye. Ziyiphayiphu le-totem elilodwa — ubuso obune besikhathi sokuzalwa esisodwa, ngalinye line-element yalo kanye ne-polarity eqinile ye-Yin noma ye-Yang yaleyo silwane.
article.fourGuides.p.enter-your-birth-da: Faka usuku lokuzalwa kwakho, isikhathi, nedolobha ku-Totem Animals Calculator. Ngemuva kokuba ipholi yakho yetotem ivele, chofoza kunoma yikuphi ikhadi le-animal ukufunda umhlahlandlela onemininingwane ngalelo totem, into yalo, nekhwalithi yalo ye-Yin noma i-Yang.
article.fourGuides.p.enter-your-birth-de: Faka imininingwane yakho yokuzalwa ukuze uveze izilwane ezisemqondweni wakho we-totem.
article.elements.p.water-wood-fire-earth: Amanzi, Uhlanga, Umlilo, Umhlaba, nezinsimbi — izifanekiso ezinhlanu zokuthi amandla ahamba kanjani esigxotsheni sakho setothemu
article.elements.figcaption.generating-c:
Ukujikeleza kokukhiqiza (igolide, cishe esangweni) — zonke izinto zondla elandelayo, phakade esiyindilinga.
Ukujikeleza kokulawula (mphefumulo, inkanyezi yangaphakathi) — zonke izinto zinciphisa enye ngaphesheya kwemoto.
article.elements.p.water-wood-fire-earth: Amanzi, Wood, Umlilo, Umhlaba, kanye neMetal — ingxenye ngayinye ye-totem yakho ihlanganisa isilwane nento eyodwa kula Ma-Elementi Amahlanu, yengeza ungqimba oluqondile lokuthungwa kuMoya wakho, Ingqondo, Inhliziyo, kanye nomzimba wakho wezilwane eziqondisayo. La Ma-Elementi Amahlanu angacatshangwa futhi njengamashidi amahlanu okunyakaza kwamandla — ngamunye anezindlela zalo, ulwazi, kanye nezinkomba zeYin & Yang.
article.elements.p.in-chinese-cosmology-: Esimisweni sokwakheka komhlaba samaShayina bahamba ngendlela ejikeleza unomphela: Amanzi anikeza amandla awo okondla kuMithi ukuze ikhule nezakhi zayo eziningi, bese izihlahla nezimfanekiso zikaMithi zinikeza umlilo izibaso zokushintsha, okudala uthuli nezibhedu ezihlala zibe uMhlaba, bese uMhlaba ubonakalisa ukuthula, isisindo, nengcindezi yokuphatha insimbi nokudala AmaKhristalu, okuphinde kunikeze izindawo ezifanele kakhulu ukuze Amanzi ahlale ahlale futhi aghoqe ukuze ukuqala kabusha kwesiyingi.
article.elements.p.inside-that-same-circ: Ngaphakathi kwalolo dreyiligayi ofanayo, iphethini yesibili yakha i-pentagram — ijubane elilawula. Ingxenye ngayinye igcina enye iphakathi: Amanzi angaphonswa emlilweni ukuwuvimbela ekuphambukeni, Umlilo ushisa futhi uthambisa Insimbi ukuze ihlale isebenza kalula, ubukhali bensimbi busika uWood ukuze kucutshungulwe okweqile, izimpande zesiWodu zibambe umhlaba ndawonye, futhi umhlaba uyamisa amanzi futhi uwaholele ngokwakha imijondolo yomfula.
article.elements.p.on-your-calculator-re: Kwaweimiphumela yekhalukuletha, into eliqondisa ngalinye libonakala ekhadini lalo.Chofoza noma yiliphi isilwaneukufunda ukuthi lelo liyingxenye nokwenzeka kobunye kuhlanganiswa kanjani epoleni lakho le-totem.
article.elements.p.water-brings-everythi: Amanzi aletha konke ngaphakathi futhi awaqondise phansi. Ungakubona lokhu kahle kakhulu kumhlaba wezifunda zokudonsa amanzi — ekuqaleni amanzi ewa ehla avela ezindaweni eziphakeme ezizungezile ukuze aqoqe phakathi bese eba umfula. Umfula-ke uphinde uzungeze phansi nangakuzungezile kuze kube sekugcineni ngisho wazi ukufika endaweni lapho wenza khona ukuwela okukhulu ube umfula ophuthumayo! Yonke leyo mandla aqondiswe phansi avela ezindaweni eziphakeme zezintaba, ehla ephansi emgudwini, edlula kuwo ezivela ezicathulweni eziningi kuze kube zonke lezo zinsiza zihlangana zibe munye kuphela, kanti lowo muye uwele ngomngcele uwile ejulile ngaphansi, eletha amanzi phansi emthonjeni wokudonsela phansi.
article.elements.p.in-its-yin-form-water: Ngokuma kwayo kwe-Yin, Amanzi afana nomfula, umusi, noma imvula — athambile futhi anesineke, angena kulo lonke induduzo futhi athole indlela engaphambili kakhulu kunokuzama ukudlula ngokuphoqelela. Amanzi e-Yin anyakazisa ngokuthula, eqoqeka ezindaweni ezifihliwe futhi eshiya isikhathi senze umsebenzi wokugqoka itshe libe bushelelezi. Awadingi ukuzazisa; aqhubeka nje ngokugeleza, evumelana nanoma yiluphi uhlobo umhlaba olunikayo kuze konke okuzungezile kuthambeke futhi kudliwe. Ngokuma kwayo kwe-Yang, Amanzi afana nolwandle oluqhuma ngamandla — engena ngaphandle nangaphakathi ngezikhathi zemijondolo, eqhuma amaza amakhulu ezintabeni, enza isiqwenga esikhulu samanzi. Amanzi e-Yang adlula konke okuma phambi kwawo, eshintsha ogwini ngenkani engenakumiswa, kunzima ukuyeka noma ukuyibamba uma sekusele isisindo sayo esiphelele esihambayo.
article.elements.p.wood-starts-as-a-seed: Izinkuni ziqala njengezimbewu enkabeni bese ngokushesha zihlangana zihlukanise ziye ezindaweni ezimbili eziphikisanayo — ithumele impande ichume phansi emhlabathini ngenkathi ngasikhathi sinye ikhula isiqu phezulu iya elangeni. Iqabula layo lokuqala livela ukuze liqoqe amandla avela phezulu ngenkathi impande yayo enkulu yokuqala ikhula ukuze ithole amanzi namaminerali avela phansi. Kusukela lapho, iyaqhubeka ukuhlukanisa ngokulandela umumo, ihlale ilinganisa ukukhula okusha ngaphezulu kweqhwa ngokuhlola okunzulu ngaphansi komhlaba. Impande iyaqhubeka ihlukanisa futhi ikhulele phansi ngokufana nokuthi amahlamvu ajikeleza ngaphandle futhi aqhubeke ekhula iziqalo ezintsha phezulu. Ukunyakaza kuqala enkabeni kusiya ngaphandle konke, kuhlukanisa futhi kujikeleze kuzo zonke izindlela ezingaba khona.
article.elements.p.in-its-yin-form-wood-: Ngesimo sayo se-Yin, Wood ifana ne-bamboo noma isihlahla esikhula sodwa — ihlala iguquguquka futhi iyakwazi ukuzivumelanisa, kodwa ithembele kwabanye, ivamise ukusebenzisa noma yini ezungezile ukusiza ekufuneni ukukhanya njengoba ikhuphuka. I-Yin Wood ngeke iphuke esivunguvungwini — ingalolonga nje ngezivunguvungu. Ngesimo sayo se-Yang ifana nesihlahla esikhulu esinamandla noma i-redwood — inzima futhi iqinile, kodwa izimele futhi iyavikela, iqhakaza phezu kwehlathi futhi inikeza uhlaka, ithente, nesivikelo kulabo abangaphansi. I-Yang Wood ingema kahle ezivunguvungwini ezincane, kodwa ekugcineni nomgogodla onamandla kakhulu uyophuka ngaphansi kwezivunguvungu eziqinile nezihlala isikhathi eside noma ukubekwa ngaphansi kwengcindezi.
article.elements.p.fire-can-be-seen-as-t: Umlilo ungabhekwa njengokuphambene naManzi — lapho Amanzi ehambisa amandla ngaphakathi nangaphansi, umlilo uyawuguqula ngokuwathumela ngaphandle nangaphezulu. Umlilo uthatha izakhiwo zoMthi esezikhona, nazo zonke ubuqili bazo, bese ulitshisa — uwashisa futhi uwaguqule, uphumeze amaqhwa nomoya oshisayo ngaphandle nangaphezulu ukuze kudaleke okuthile okusha kukho konke ukonakala: ukushisa, ukukhanya, noshizi oshisayo owela phansi futhi ekugcineni uba uMhlaba oMisiwe. Umlilo ukhulula izinto ngaphakathi kwendlela oya kuyo, ushiya isikhala esivulekile lapho ngaphambili bekukhona umqalo ohlangene ukhula ukhula omkhulu nolukhuni lapha phansi. Umlilo usabalala, uhlale ukhula ngaphandle, uhlale ukhuphuka phezulu, kuze kufike ukuthi amahemuhemu awo athinte izulu uqobo.
article.elements.p.in-its-yin-form-fire-: Ngokwefomu yayo ye-Yin, Umlilo ufana kakhulu nesibani noma isiqhumi — uthambile, uvinjelwe, futhi uthandekile ukukhanyisa indlela abantu ababona ngayo. Umlilo we-Yin unikeza ukufudumala ngaphandle kokufuna ukubhubhisa; udinga ukunakekelwa kanye nomlilo, kodwa ungashisa ngokuzinzile ebusuku obude, ugcina umlilo owodwa emehlweni emnyama. Ukhanyisa kunokuba ubhubhise, uwumema labo abaseduze ukuthi basondele. Ngokwefomu yayo ye-Yang, ufana kakhulu nelanga noma umlilo wezihlahla — ushisayo kakhulu futhi ushisa konke okusesimweni sakhe. Umlilo we-Yang usakazeka ngaphandle kokubuza, ukhuphuka phezulu nangaphandle kuze kube akukho okusele kungashintshi, ususa konke okudala ngokuphelele ukuze okuthile okusha kuqale.
article.elements.p.earth-brings-everythi: Umhlaba uletha konke ekuphumuleni. Lapho Umlilo usuqedile ukuqhuma kwawo, lokho okuwa akusakhuphuki noma kusakazeke — kuyahlala. Imfucuza iyawa phansi. Izibani ziyabanda. Uthuli luthola indawo ephansi kakhulu luma. Ungakubona lokhu kulo lonke elasezansi: udaka olwela lapho isigameko sesiphela, umhlabathi uvalwe ungqimba ngaphezu kokuqhathaniswa ngaphansi kwehlathi naphakathi kwamapulazi, umhlaba ngaphansi kwezinyawo zakho ukuma kuhle kuyilapho konke okunye kuqhubeka kuhamba ngaphezulu kwakho. Umhlaba uqoqela isisindo, ucindezele phansi, bese uhlala nje — ukuhamba kwamandla okufika ekuphumuleni lapho ekhona, ucindezela phansi ngenhlalakahle engidingi ukuya kwenye indawo.
article.elements.p.in-its-yin-form-earth: Ngomumo wayo we-Yin, Umhlaba ufana nomsele — ogobile ngobumnene, izintaba ezincane eziphumulekayo, wamukela konke ngokwehla uye phakathi, unikeza umhlabathi omusha lapho izimpande zingathatha khona indawo. Umhlaba we-Yin wamukela futhi ugcina — indawo ethambileyo yokuwela kwanoma yini, unesineke esanele sokuvumela impilo ukuba izame futhi iphumelele phezu kwawo ngaphandle kokuzidlula. Ngomumo wayo we-Yang, uwufana nentaba — iziqu ezinamandla, izindawo eziyinqaba kuzo zonke izingxenye, ume ngokungesabi emhlabeni, uvulekile emoyeni nasemisebenzini yesimo sezulu kodwa ugcina indawo yawo ngokuzimisela okuqinile ngaphakathi. Umhlaba we-Yang awugogi kalula noma awunikezi kalula; uphatha isisindo esiphakeme futhi uvikela ukonakala, ume njengendawo eqinisekisiwe ngesikhathi konke okunye kushintsha kuyo.
article.elements.p.metal-also-thought-of: Insimbi — okucatshangwa nangokuthi iKhrisitali — ihlanganisa lokho okusakazeke futhi ikudonsela ngaphakathi emgogodleni owodwa. Lapho uWood ukhula kuwela yonke imikhakha ukusuka embewu, Insimbi ihamba ngendlela ephambene: ihlanganisa ubukhulu, ingcindezi, kanye nentsimbi engenangqondo evela emahlombe eMhlaba iye enhliziyweni eyodwa ehlungiwe. Ungabona lokhu endleleni lapho insimbi engagqwali icutshungulwa yaba ingxube yensimbi ehlanzekile, indlela inhlabathi nokushisa kuhlanganiswa yaba ingilazi enedge elilodwa elicacile, ngendlela ukhuni lwenziwe uma amandla avela kuzo zonke izinhlangothi ekucindezelani isakhiwo sekhrisitali sibe ngesinye isimo esidingwa ubumsulwa bayo. Ukunyakaza kungaphakathi futhi kugxile — kusuka kuyo yonke indawo kuya maphakathi, kuhlanganisa kuze kube akukho okuphunyuka ngobubanzi eminye.
article.elements.p.in-its-yin-form-metal: Ngokuma kwayo kweYin, Insimbi ifana nekristalu, idayimani, noma izimonyo ezinhle — ingcindezi evela kuzo zonke iziqondiso iphoqa indaba ukuba ibe ngesimo esiphelele, esibhalwe futhi esicacile, isigcina isimo sayo ngaphandle kokudinga ukusika noma ukusabalalisa. Insimbi yeYin igxila ekubukekeni nasekubalulekeni ngaphakathi, inikeza ukuhlanzeka nokucaca kulabo abayiqondayo kunokuhamba yedwa. Ngokuma kwayo kweYang ifana kakhulu nommese noma inkemba — ubukhulu obubucayi buzanywe kakhulu buze bufike emaphethelweni ebhedu, buhlanzwe ukuze busike emoyeni kalula kakhulu, bufisa ukusika indlela buze buphume eduze kakhulu lapho okuhloswe khona. Insimbi yeYang ihlukanisa, ihlukanisa ngokucacile okuhlomile kulokho okungelona, futhi ngeke ithintele ukuthulula lapho umzuzu usudinga.
article.yinYang.p.two-fundamental-ways-t: Izindlela ezimbili eziyisisekelo zokuhamba kwamandla — ezifakwe kuzo zonke izilwane zamatotemu kusukela ekuqaleni.
article.yinYang.p.before-rainbow-compani: Ngaphambi kwezihambeli ze-Rainbow, izibopho ze-Shadow, noma yimuphi umqondo wokuhlanganisa, iYin neYang izindlela ezimbili eziyisisekelo zokuhamba kwamandla. Ku Totem Astrology, i-polarity ifakwe kukho konke isilwane kusukela ekuqaleni — i-Squirrel ihlala inguYang, i-Buffalo ihlala inguYin, i-Tiger ihlala inguYang, i-Cat ihlala inguYin, njalo njalo kuze kube zonke ezilishumi nambili. Emakhadini akho wokubala zivelela njenge Yang (+) noma Yin (−) kanye nohlobo lwalelo silwane.
article.yinYang.p.they-are-not-good-and-: Abakho “buhle” noma “bubi,” futhi abakwazi ukuba amadoda noma abesifazane ngokuqinile. Bangamaphethini aphakanyisayo — izingxenye ezimbili zento eyodwa ezidingana ukuze zihlale zilinganisiwe.
article.yinYang.p.squirrel-tiger-dragon-: Isesilwane sesikhwama, Ingonyama, Idrako, Ihhashi, Inkawu, no Inja — izilwane eziyisithupha zeYang, njalo ziphume ngaphandle ngokwemvelo yazo eyinhloko.
article.yinYang.p.buffalo-cat-snake-deer: Inkomo yasendle, Ikati, Inyoka, Ihhashi, Ifiniki, kanye IBhere — izilwane ezinhlanu ze-Yin, ezihlala ngaphakathi emvelweni wazo oyinhloko.
article.yinYang.p.yang-is-the-quality-of: Yang yikhwalithi yeukuqala, ukwandisa, nokuphawula. Ihamba iya emhlabeni obonakalayo. Amandla e-Yang enza, akhulumise, aphushise phambili, futhi aziveze. Ihlale ikhanya, isebenza, futhi iveze ngqo — ingxenye yakho ephuma phandle, ethatha umthwalo, iqala ingxoxo, noma ifaka umbono ekuqaleni ngaphambi kokuba iphelele.
article.yinYang.p.yang-is-not-recklessne: UYang akuyona ukungacabangi, nakuba uYang ongahloliwe angaqala ukuba njalo. Ngokuhamba kahle kungumshoshaphansi, ukucaca, nokuzimisela ukubonakala. Yakha, iqondisa, ivikela ngaphezulu, futhi iletha ukushisa nokunyakaza. Cabanga ngelanga emhlabathini ovulekile — likhanyisa, lishisa, lizele ukuphila phezulu ebusweni.
article.yinYang.p.yin-is-the-quality-of-: Yin wumsebenzi weukwamukela, ukujulisa, nokuphothula. Ihamba iya ngaphakathi. Amandla e-Yin ayahlangana, abambe, alalele, futhi ahlolisise. Lithambekele ekuthuleni, ekwamukeleni, nasekuthonyeni okuncane — ingxenye yakho ewamukela okwenzeka, ekhulisela lokho okuqalile, futhi iyazi ukuthi nini kufanele ulinde kunokuphoqa.
article.yinYang.p.yin-is-not-passivity-t: I-Yin ayisho ukuba nokungasebenzi, nakuba uma ingalawulwa i-Yin ingaba ukudonsa emuva. Ngokuyikho okuhle kakhulu, iyi-hlakanipho, ukubekezela, namandla okuphelela. Iqedela lokho i-Yang eqala khona, izinzisa lokho i-Yang ephazamisa, futhi ithola amandla ekuzivumeleni kunokulwa. Cabanga ukukhanya kwenyanga emanzini — ukukhanyisa, ukuhlanganisa, ukuthwala ukujula ngaphandle kwesidingo sokukhala.
article.yinYang.p.neither-pole-is-comple: Akekho ophambili ongaphelele ngaphandle komunye. iYang engenayo iYin iyasha noma iqhube ngamandla; iYin engenayo iYang iyamisa noma ifihle. Uphawu lukathembele olulinganiselayo — nempilo enempilo — luyafunda ukuhlonipha womabili: ukwazi ukuthi yisiphi isikhathi sokunyathelisa phambili nokuthi yisiphi isikhathi sokuyeka emuva, ukuthi nini ukukhuluma nokuthi nini ukukuzwa, ukuthi nini ukucindezela nokuthi nini ukubamba.
article.yinYang.p.in-totem-astrology-pol: Ku-Totem Astrology, i-polarity ingeyasilo ngokwaso. Lapho iTiger ivele esigabeni sakho setotem — kuMoya, Engqondweni, Enhliziyweni, noma Emzimbeni — ihlala inguYang. Lapho iCat ivele, ihlala inguYin. I-element kulelo gumbi lisashintsha esigabeni sakho setotem, ngakho iYang Fire Squirrel neYang Water Squirrel zifundeka ngokuhlukile — kodwa imvelo yeYang yeSquirrel ayikashintshi nhlobo.
article.yinYang.h3.where-yin-yang-go-nex: Lapho i-Yin ne-Yang baya khona ngokulandelayo
article.yinYang.p.once-you-understand-yi: Uma usuqonda iYin neYang njengezinto ezizimele, uhlelo lusebenzisa lezi ngokubambisana. Ekhasini le-Amanani Ezintathu, Ozakwethu beerainbow bayizikhawu zeYin–Yang ezilinganisela futhi ezigcwalisa omunye nomunye — kanti Ozakwethu bemthunzi bayizinguquko zabo zemagnethi, ziveza lokho okumele kubhekwe futhi kufakwe phakathi.
article.yinYang.p.those-connection-types: Lawa mahlobo oxhumano akhiwa kuleli sangqa. Awawona esikhundleni sokuqonda ukuthi uYin noYang kusho ukuthini bodwa.
article.yinYang.h2.see-yin-yang-on-your-: Bona i-Yin & Yang Ku-Totem Pole Yakho
article.yinYang.p.your-four-guides-each-: Izihambi zakho ezine ngayinye ziphethe ukuphawula kwezilwane okungashintshi kanye nesici esikwi-totem yakho — faka imininingwane yakho yokuzalwa ukuze uthole eyakho.
article.nepalTime.p.from-the-jade-empero: Ukusuka kuNkosi uJade phezulu ezintabeni zaseKun Lun ukuya endaweni yokuzalwa kukaBuddha eNepal — kungani siguqula ku-NPT ngaphambi kokuba izilwane zakho zidwebe.
article.nepalTime.p.before-your-animals-: Ngaphambi kokubalwa kwezilwane zakho, sishintsha isikhathi sokuzalwa kwakho sibe Isikhathi saseNepal (NPT, UTC+5:45) — ukushintshwa kwesikhathi okususelwa ekutholeni okuqondile ukuthi le ndlela ebizwa ngokuthi “I-Astrology YaseShayina” empeleni isuselwa ezinkolelweni ngamaMkhosi eJade, ohlala phezulu eJade Mountain eK’un Lun Mountain Range esebenza njengomngcele osenyakatho eTibet. Lokhu bese kudluliselwa kithi abantu ngobuBuddha, lapho izwe lakhe lokuzalwa ngokwesiko lithathwa ukuthi liseNepal. Ngakho-ke ukuguqula izikhathi zokuzalwa zibe yisiNgisi saseNepal kuqala kusiza izilwane zosuku nehora ukuthi zihambisane namazwi abantu emhlabeni wonke abawavumayo ezinhliziyweni nasezizimweni zabo.
article.nepalTime.p.in-myths-the-jade-em: Ezindabeni zemiqingo, iJade Emperor yakuhlala eJade Castle of Abstraction, phezulu kakhulu emhlabeni nasemazulwini angamashumi amathathu nantathu, ngokwezinye izibalo; noma ngokwezinye, eMountain of Jade eK’un Lun range. Lapha, ogwini lweJade Lake, kwakukhula isihlahla seJade, esilinganiselwa emithanjeni yamadolo angamakhulu amathathu futhi esiqhamuka kulo isithelo se-jade esibomvu sasephezulu sasinikeza isipho sokuphila okungapheli.
article.nepalTime.p.if-you-enter-your-bi: Uma ufaka isikhathi sokuzalwa kwakho njengokurekhodwa kusitifiketi sokuzalwa kwakho — ngokwesibonelo, 3:15 PM eDenver noma 9:00 AM eLondon — isibali sokuqala sihlonipha leso sikhathi sendawo ngokunembile. Bese, ngaphambi kokubalwa kwanoma iyiphi ipayipi, siguqula leso sikhathi sibe Isikhathi saseNepal futhi sisebenzisa leso sikhathi esishintshelwe ku-totem pole yakho.
article.nepalTime.p.on-the-calculator-re: Emiphumeleni yekhalikhuletha, uzohlala ubona kokubili izikhathi eceleni: isikhathi osifakile, isikhathi sedolobha lakho lokuzalwa, kanye nesikhathi esifanayo Sikhathi saseNepal (NPT) esisetshenziselwa ukubalwa kwangempela. Uma uzalwe eKathmandu, ukushintsha kungase kungabonakali — kodwa eziningi zokuzalwa emhlabeni jikelele, ukuguqulwa kubalulekile.
article.nepalTime.p.read-more-of-the-per: Funda kabanzi ngendaba yomuntu siqu ngemuva kalesi sithombe ekhasini le-Mayelana.
article.nepalTime.p.the-calculator-shows: Isibali sibonisa isikhathi sakho sokuzalwa sendawo kanye neSikhathi saseNepal esisetshenziselwa izinsika zakho.
article.sacredRoles.p.seeker-mage-and-ro: Umfuna, Umthakathi, neNkosi — izindlela ezintathu ezehlukene zonke izilwane ze-Values Triangle ezihlangana ngazo nenani lazo eliyinhloko.
article.sacredRoles.p.the-same-archetypa: Isakhiwo esifanayo esiyisibonelo siphindwa kuwo wonke ama-Triangle Amaqiniso. I-triangle ngayinye iyiqembu lezilwane ezintathu okuhlanganisa i-Seeker eyodwa, i-Mage eyodwa, ne-Royal eyodwa — izindlela ezintathu ezehlukene zokuphatha iCore Value yalo Triangle. Isilwane ngasinye simelela iCore Value yaso njengembhaxu, kodwa sithanda ukufinyelela kuyo ngendlela yabo ehlukile.
article.sacredRoles.li.the-seeker-in-eve: Umfuna — Kuwo wonke amathathu, Umfuna nguye olandela, athole, futhi aqoqe Inani Eliyinhloko, edonswa ukuze aqoqe okwengeziwe kulo noma alakhe yena ngokwakhe kuye ngokuthanda kwakhe. Ngokwesibonelo, Abafuna Amandla Nokuhlangana bayavame ukufuna ngokushesha Inani Labo Eliyinhloko, belilandela ngesikhathi Abafuna Umuzwa Wokuhle Nokuphepha bethatha indima eqondile yokwakha Inani Labo Eliyinhloko ngokuqondile, beqala lapho abakule khona. Umfuna Wokuphepha uqala ukusebenza ngokubeka izitini zePiramidi ngakunye ngakunye, kanti Umfuna Wokuhle uthanda Inkululeko kuwo wonke umzila ngomdlandla ohlanzekile owethusa umuntu ukuthi ayeke noma azame ukudambisa. BayiMashayeli weqembu ngalinye, beqinisekisa ukuthi izinto ziyafezeka futhi amaMpilo akhiwa, bekhuthaza ukuthi iqembu linakekelwe futhi beqinisekisa ukuthi wonke umuntu unendawo yokuphumula ekupheleni kobusuku.
article.sacredRoles.li.the-mage-each-mag: Umthakathi — Umthakathi ngamunye esithenjini sawo uyaqonda Inani Lakhe Eliyisisekelo ngokweqile kuze kube sengathi liyinto yokudlala. Ngakho-ke bayajabula ukusebenza ngemuva kwezindawo, besebenzisa Inani Labo Eliyisisekelo ngokucophelela futhi bethumela amandla abo kulo ngenhloso yokucabanga. Kubo kungumdlalo kunokuba ubunzima obubulalayo obusetshenziswa emigomweni emibili eminye ukuthatha Inani labo Eliyisisekelo. Ngezinye izikhathi, abathakathi bangase bangaqondakali ukuthi banalo Inani Labo Eliyisisekelo nhlobo, kodwa lokhu kungukubukeka nje - bangakwazi ukufinyelela kukho ngokushesha okukhulu nganoma yisiphi isikhathi. Abathakathi bazibophezele ezinhlosweni zabo njengomuntu wonke, bazokwenza kahle nje ukuhamba emngceleni nokuhlola imingcele ngohambo lonke. Ukudlalisa kuyengxenye yalesi sipho, kodwa banokuqonda okuhle kwe-Inani Labo Eliyisisekelo noma nini lapho liqoka ngempela.
article.sacredRoles.li.the-royal-these-f: I-Royal — Lezi zilwane ezine zimelela Inani Lazo Eliyisisekelo phakathi nempilo yazo yonke, zisebenza njengezibonelo zazo futhi ziphatha lelo nani eliyisisekelo ngemvelo yokuba negunya. Ngenxa yalokhu, abanye bazalandela imikhuba yazo, ngakho-ke imithetho ka-Spiderman iyasebenza: amandla amakhulu afika nemithwalo emikhulu! Ama-Royal ngokuvamile acabanga ukuthi anomthelela ophakeme, futhi lokhu kucatshangelwa kusebenza kahle ekutholeni ukuthi angaphambili emgqeni futhi aqonde phakathi esiteji. Ubuciko bukhona ekunciphiseni ukuthi akuyona nje ingxenye yokuhlala phambi; futhi kunzima ukusebenza! Abantu bacabanga ngqo ngawe mayelana nesiqondiso, ngakho-ke lowo mqondo wokwazi ukuthi yini okufanele uyenze ngokulandelayo kufanele ube usizo hhayi kuphela kuwe kodwa nakubona bonke ababukelayo ukuthi izinto zenziwa kanjani. Ama-Royal azalwa njengabaholi abenza kahle kakhulu ekukhanyisweni kwesithunzi sokubonisa okubalulekile.
article.sacredRoles.p.what-follows-on-th: Okulandelayo ekhasini le-Values Triangles wumthetho ojwayelekile walelithi le-triangle ngayinye: izilwane ezintathu nokuthi ngayinye iphila kanjani indima yayo njengoMﬁlandile, uMage, noma iNkosi.
article.sacredRoles.four-royals.p.of-the: Kwezilwane eziyishumi nambili ze-totem, ezine ziphethe Indima Engcwele Yobukhosi — eyodwa ku-Triangle ngayinye Yamanani. Ngokuhlanganyela zakha ubukhosi obuphindwe kabili phezu kwe-zodiac: iDragon nePhoenix njengenkosi nengoma yeCelestial Realm, kanye neTiger neBear njengenkosi nengoma yeEarthly Realm.
article.sacredRoles.four-royals.p.the-dr: I-Dragon ne-Phoenix zibusa ezweni lemibono nasezakhiweni ezingenakuthintwa zokuqonda — izifanekiso, izimemezelo, amazinga, kanye nobunjiniyela bokuthi izinto kufanele zigcinwe kanjani engqondweni ngaphambi kokuba ziphilwe emzimbeni. I-Dragon ivikela amandla nezifanekiso zobuhle; i-Phoenix isimemezela ukuphepha ngokusebenzisa ubuhle, ukuboniswa, kanye nesithembiso esibonakalayo sokuthi konke kuhamba kahle.

Isilwane esifanayo sothembele ezingeni elifanayo — umuntu ohlanganyela umoya wakho, ingqondo, inhliziyo, noma umzimba ngendlela efanayo. Kungaba futhi abantu abavela ku-'rings' ezehlukene ngokusho kokukhuluma — ngenye indlela, abantu abazalwe iminyaka engu-12, 24, 36, noma enye inani elihlanganayo le-12 evela kuwe. Ngokwesibonelo, mina ngiyiNgonyama yomlilo ezalwe ngo-1986, kodwa nginabo abangani nomndeni wami abakhulu beNgonyama abavela kuma-ring ahlukene eNgonyama — omunye wamalungu omndeni wami u-uncle unguyiNgonyama Yamanzi ezalwe ngo-1962, indodana yami inguNgonyama Yensimbi ezalwa ngo-2010, futhi abangani abaningi abathandekayo, abafundi, kanye nabalingani bangamaNgonyama Amoshozalayo abazakhele umhlaba ezalwa ngo-1998. Ngibe nabalingani abasebenza nabo abazalwe ngonyaka weNgonyama Wensimu yobuhlanga, ngo-1974. Kungaba kujabulisa ukubona ukuthi izilwane zakho zithini lapho zinamandla ahlukene okuphakelwa kwabanye abantu. Kungaba kuhle futhi ukuthola abantu abazalwe ngosuku olufanayo nawe, ukuze babe nazo zonke izilwane eziyiziqondiso ezifanayo, noma okungenani ezintathu kwezine uma isilwane sesikhathi sihlukile, futhi ukubona ukuthi bakhethe kanjani ukuhlela izandla zabo ngendlela ehlukile kunaleyo oseyikhethile — okufana nendlela amawele 'afanayo' ahlukile ngayo ngezindlela eziningi, kodwa ehlanganyela izinto eziningi kwezinye izindawo. Inhloso yakho yokuzikhethela iyinto enamandla, futhi lokhu kuxhumana kukhombisa lokho ngokucacile kakhulu. Izilwane zokuzalwa eziqondisayo zifanayo, kodwa abantu abaqondiswa yizo basaphuma behlukile ngokuphelele futhi kahle kakhulu :)
